note: Copilot & AI #18. Only check is free and offline. embedded, plugin and agent need Security Copilot capacity: with Microsoft 365 E5 it is auto-provisioned (400 SCU a month per 1,000 licences); otherwise provision 1 SCU with overage 0 (US$4 per SCU per hour, billed per started hour) and delete it right after recording. agent also needs Microsoft Entra ID P1. Never invent an incident: use a real one in the lab or skip embedded. Never apply the Conditional Access suggestion. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: # manual (owner): sign in to security.microsoft.com, the Entra admin center and securitycopilot.microsoft.com as alex.demo (Security Administrator); about 12 failed sign-ins for jordan.demo (wrong password in a private window)

# manual (owner): capacity: option (a) E5 auto-provisioned, nothing to do; option (b) in-product Provision capacity within Security Copilot, 1 SCU, overage 0, note the start time (the clock hour is billed)
# manual (owner): upload plugin\contoso-soc-hunting.yaml (Plugin button, Manage plugins, Custom, Add plugin) and optionally agent\contoso-signin-triage-agent.yaml (prerelease)

screens.name: check
screens.note: Expected: Passed: 115, 0 errors 0 warnings, then the red lines of the broken plugin (unquoted placeholder, AccountUPN, old table name, gpt-4o).

screens.name: plugin
steps: Open Security Copilot standalone; Plugin button on the prompt bar, Custom: show Contoso SOC hunting listed
Type: Show failed sign-ins for jordan.demo@contoso.example
Record the real answer and the skill name in the activity trail (GetFailedSignInsByUser; it may need the input upn typed in the prompt)
mask: tenant name in the address bar and account menu
capacity name and subscription id on the capacity page
real IP addresses of real sign-ins

then.name: plugin-render
commands: dotnet run --project src/SecCopilotKit.Cli -- render plugin/contoso-soc-hunting.yaml GetFailedSignInsByUser "upn=jordan.demo@contoso.example"

screens.name: embedded
steps: Defender portal, Incidents: open a REAL incident, Copilot tab: show the generated summary, then Recommendations
Entra admin center, Protection, ID Protection, Risky users: open a user and select Summarize
Record what the tenant really produces; if no real incident exists skip this scene (a test alert from the Defender portal is fine)
mask: tenant name in every address bar and profile menu

screens.name: agent
steps: Entra admin center, Agents, Conditional Access Optimization, Start agent as Security Administrator (no PIM-activated role)
Show the activity map and one suggestion (policy in report-only mode)
mask: tenant name in the address bar and profile menu
policy names that contain the real domain
screens.note: Needs Security Copilot capacity and Microsoft Entra ID P1 (P2 for the risky-user suggestions).

teardown: # manual (owner): DELETE the Security Copilot capacity (option b) and confirm no provisioned SCU remains; remove the custom plugin and agent from Custom; leave Conditional Access Optimization suggestions unapplied and turn the agent off; remove the Phishing Triage Agent if set up; remove or reset the jordan.demo test user; sign out of all portals
needs: paid:security-copilot-capacity (E5 auto-provisioned, or 1 SCU at US$4 per started hour; delete after recording)
blocked: plugin, embedded and agent need Security Copilot capacity (owner decision, billed per started hour unless E5 auto-provisions it); agent also needs Microsoft Entra ID P1; embedded needs a real Defender incident. Only check can be recorded now.
